payload.text: hv, 2026-10-03, ruling on 0152 and the bundle. (1) devbin keeps NO list of who uses it, in its runtime or in its tests: such a list is an inverted dependency, so a gate works by shape and review holds names. (2) Licence: Geodica Ltd (geodica.com), all rights reserved, one text at LICENSE and lib/LICENSE.md, byte-identical by test, replacing the root MIT. A client may use, copy and run a delivered project's copy as part of that project and takes no ownership. (3) Fix and fail forward: every open item is an issue, never a thread, built by cc, reviewed by vc, and landed into ONE bundled release that hv cuts. (4) Intentv2's reference in fleet code comes out (cc's 0154 rider); Intentv2 is otherwise never raised. (5) intent/docs/devbin-users.md is hv's convenience: ignore it.
